title: Modeling Ideological Salience and Framing in Polarized Online Groups with Graph Neural Networks and Structured Sparsity

bias_targets.methodology: Combining graph neural networks with structured sparsity on social network graphs (Reddit) to detect ideologically polarized concepts based on their salience (relative frequency) and framing (contextualized BERT embeddings projected into moral foundation subspaces), and extrinsically validating the findings by predicting DW-NOMINATE ideological leaning scores of US states.
